name: Kamoi Yuma
source: Protagonist's childhood friend who often does domestic chores in his house. They've known each other since kindergarten. She's a bit unfriendly towards strangers, but soft to childhood friends Ryouta and Makoto. Still, there is something more to her personality than meets the eye.
